purpose: Logged-replay diagnostics only; no causal return estimate from unexecuted recommendations.

interpretation.single_source: Disable cross-source predictive calibration to prevent performance evidence from entering a workload-only or operating-only baseline indirectly.
interpretation.coverage: Coverage is relative to the enabled set; single-source uncertainty is not comparable as a calibrated probability.
interpretation.equal_fixed: Their weights do not depend on calibrated reliability; no-predictive-calibration isolates that factor in the reliability mode.
interpretation.no_disagreement: Retains missing-source penalties, masking, and resource constraints.
interpretation.no_delayed_value: Removes future training credit and retains current inference value and all costs.
